column1: # passage/question | translation of passage and question | key | distractor | distractor | why | pitfall

The red basket is for used pencils. The yellow basket holds new ones. Mei needs a pencil that nobody has used. Which basket should she open?|红篮子装用过的铅笔，黄篮子装新铅笔。梅需要一支没人用过的铅笔。她该打开哪个篮子？|The yellow basket.|The red basket.|Both baskets.|nobody has used 与 new 表达相同条件，因此应选黄篮子。|先看梅的具体需求，再选颜色。

At the pool, Dan leaves his shoes by the door and puts his glasses in a locker. What does Dan put in the locker?|在游泳池，丹把鞋留在门旁，把眼镜放进储物柜。他把什么放进了储物柜？|His glasses.|His shoes.|His towel.|第二个动作 puts his glasses in a locker 直接给出物品。|by the door 说明鞋在另一处。

A note says, “Lunch is in the fridge. Please heat it first. Love, Dad.” What should the reader do before eating?|便条写着：“午餐在冰箱里。请先加热。爱你的爸爸。”读者在吃饭之前应该做什么？|Heat the lunch.|Buy the lunch.|Put the lunch in the fridge.|heat it first 给出吃之前的指令，it 指午餐。|冰箱是午餐现在的位置，不是下一步动作。

The small train leaves the park gate at 10:00. It stops at the lake at 10:15. Where is it scheduled to be at 10:15?|小火车十点离开公园大门，十点十五分停在湖边。按时刻表，十点十五分它应在哪里？|At the lake.|At the park gate.|At the station outside the park.|10:15 对应 stops at the lake。|区分出发地点与停靠地点。

Nina counts her coins. She has five yuan. A bun costs three yuan and a pear costs two. What can she buy with exactly five yuan?|妮娜有五元钱。一个小圆面包三元，一个梨两元。正好花五元，她能买什么？|One bun and one pear.|Two buns.|One pear only.|一个面包和一个梨合计 3＋2＝5 元。|题目要求“恰好”五元，只买梨会剩钱。

“Please bring a spoon. We have enough bowls,” reads the picnic note. Which item is each guest asked to bring?|野餐留言写着：“请带一把勺子。我们有足够的碗。”每位客人被要求带哪样东西？|A spoon.|A bowl.|A picnic table.|bring 的宾语是 a spoon；碗已经够用。|不要把提到的每样东西都当作需要携带的物品。

The blue door is locked. A sign on it says, “Visitors, please use the green door on your left.” Where should a visitor go?|蓝色门锁着。上面的标牌写着：“访客请使用左边的绿色门。”访客应该去哪儿？|To the green door.|To the blue door on the right.|To the back of the building.|标牌直接指向左边的绿门。|locked 表明蓝门无法作为入口。

Tara's lunch bag has a picture of a boat. The bag with a star belongs to her brother. Which picture identifies Tara's bag?|塔拉的午餐包上画着一艘船，带星星的包属于哥哥。哪个图案能辨认出塔拉的包？|A boat.|A star.|A boat and a star.|第一句把 Tara 的包与船对应起来。|不要把哥哥包上的图案也算在塔拉的包上。
One seed is in a glass jar. Two seeds are in a paper cup. How many seeds are in the cup?|玻璃罐里有一粒种子，纸杯里有两粒。纸杯里有几粒种子？|Two.|One.|Three.|第二句提供杯中的数量 two。|三粒是两容器的总数，问题只问纸杯。

A shop closes at six. At five, a sign in the window says, “Open.” Can a customer enter at five?|一家店六点关门。五点时，橱窗里的牌子写着“营业中”。顾客五点可以进店吗？|Yes, the shop is still open.|No, the shop has closed.|Only if the customer has a ticket.|五点早于关门时间，Open 也确认店正在营业。|票在文中没有被列作入店条件。

A class will meet in Room 4 for drawing. If that room is being cleaned, the class will use Room 6. Today a cleaner is washing the floor in Room 4. Where should the class meet?|班级本要在四号教室画画，若那里正在打扫，就改用六号教室。今天清洁员正在四号教室洗地。班级该在哪里集合？|Room 6.|Room 4.|The school entrance.|清洁员正在洗地，满足使用备用教室的条件。|第一句是原安排，阅读后文检查是否有变化。

Tom wants to borrow a book for seven days. At this library, novels may be kept for two weeks, but magazines for only three days. Which item meets his plan?|汤姆想借一本读物留七天。这里的小说可借两周，杂志只能借三天。哪一种适合他的计划？|A novel.|A magazine.|Either item for seven days.|两周超过七天，三天不足七天，因此小说符合。|比较的是可借上限，并非必须借满两周。

The blue team finished its poster first. The yellow team won because its directions were easier to follow. What did the judges value in this decision?|蓝队最先完成海报，黄队因指引更易理解而获胜。裁判在这次决定中看重什么？|Clear directions.|Finishing first.|Using blue paint.|because 后明确说明获胜理由是指引清楚。|先完成和最终获胜分别属于两个队。

Ravi's music lesson starts at 4:20. It takes him fifteen minutes to walk there. He leaves home at 4:00. How much time will he have before the lesson if he walks as usual?|拉维的音乐课四点二十分开始，步行需十五分钟。他四点出门。若按平常速度走，到后离上课还有多久？|Five minutes.|Fifteen minutes.|Twenty minutes.|四点十五分到达，与四点二十分相差五分钟。|路上所用时间与到达后的空余时间不同。

The notice at a fruit stall says, “Bring your own box on Saturdays and get one extra plum.” Liz brings a box on Friday. Does the notice promise her an extra plum that day?|水果摊通知说：“周六自带盒子，可多得一个李子。”莉兹周五带了盒子。通知承诺当天多给她一个李子吗？|No, the offer is for Saturdays.|Yes, because she has a box.|Yes, because it is Friday.|自带盒子和周六是同时满足的条件；莉兹来的是周五。|只看到有盒子会漏掉日期限制。

The puppy runs to the kitchen whenever it hears the tin lid. Today the tin is empty, but the puppy still runs in. What brought it into the kitchen this time?|小狗一听到罐盖声就会跑向厨房。今天罐子是空的，它仍跑了进来。这次是什么引它进厨房？|The sound of the lid.|The sight of food.|A call from its owner.|whenever 与 still 说明小狗对盖子的声音作出反应。|罐子是空的，因此看到食物不是文中原因。

A text reads, “Meet me outside the bakery, not inside. The tables there are full.” What is the sender changing or clarifying?|短信说：“在面包店外面见，不在里面。那里的桌子都满了。”发信人在说明什么？|The exact meeting place.|The meeting day.|The price of bread.|outside 与 inside 是地点对照，桌满解释了这样安排的原因。|店名相同，改变的是店内还是店外。

A family ticket covers two adults and one child. Jo arrives with one adult and two children. Which detail differs from the ticket description?|一张家庭票含两名成人和一名儿童。乔一行有一名成人和两名儿童。哪一点与票面说明不同？|The mix of adults and children.|The total number of people.|The name of the ticket.|两组都是三人，但成人和儿童的人数分别不同。|总人数相同不代表票的构成条件也相同。

A coach tells Ken, “Your first lap was quick. Save a little energy for the last lap next time.” What change is the coach suggesting?|教练对肯说：“你第一圈很快。下次给最后一圈留点体力。”教练建议他怎样调整？|Start at a pace he can keep up.|Run the first lap even faster.|Skip the last lap.|留体力说明起步要更可持续，而不是加快第一圈。|“第一圈快”是观察，建议在后一句。

A diary entry says, “Monday: I put the wet umbrella by the window. Tuesday: The wind had dried it, so I folded it.” When did the writer fold the umbrella?|日记写着：“周一：我把湿伞放在窗旁。周二：风已经把它吹干，于是我收起了伞。”作者何时收伞？|On Tuesday, after it had dried.|On Monday, before it was dry.|On Tuesday, while it was still wet.|周二条目中先说已干，再说 folded，可确定日期和先后。|不要把放伞和收伞看成同一天的同一动作。

A town tested a quiet hour in one market. Twenty shoppers filled in cards; fifteen liked the change. What can the cards show directly?|镇上在一处市场试行安静时段。二十名顾客填写反馈卡，十五人喜欢这一变化。反馈卡能直接说明什么？|Most people who returned a card liked the change.|Most people in town liked the change.|Every market should hold a quiet hour.|十五占二十的大多数，结论范围限于交回卡片的人。|不能把小范围自愿反馈扩大到全镇。

The route map marks a footbridge with a dotted line. Its key says dotted lines mean “planned.” A walker needs to cross the river today. What should she check?|路线图上人行桥为虚线，图例说明虚线表示“规划中”。行人今天要过河。她应该核实什么？|Whether a usable crossing exists now.|Whether the dotted line is blue.|Whether the river has a name.|planned 说明地图记录的是规划；现在通行与否仍需确认。|地图上画了桥不等于桥已经建成。

A cafe sells soup until 2 p.m., but sandwiches until closing at 5. Mia arrives at 2:30 and wants a hot soup and a sandwich. Which part of her order is still listed as available?|咖啡店下午两点停止供应汤，三明治卖到五点打烊。米娅两点半到，想要热汤和三明治。哪一样仍在供应时段？|The sandwich only.|The soup only.|Both the soup and the sandwich.|两点半已过供汤时间，却早于三明治停售时间。|同一家店的不同餐品有各自截止时间。

A group washed three stained shirts with a new soap. All three looked cleaner. They did not wash any shirt with their usual soap that day. Which comparison is missing?|一组人用新肥皂洗了三件脏衬衫，三件看起来都更干净。那天他们没用惯常的肥皂洗任何衬衫。缺少哪项比较？|How the usual soap would clean similar stains.|How many shirts they washed with the new soap.|Whether the shirts looked cleaner afterward.|惯常肥皂未参与测试，因此无法与新肥皂比较效果。|变干净说明有变化，不能据此判定优于其他肥皂。

A volunteer writes, “I can water the seedlings every evening except Thursday. Could someone cover that day?” What does cover mean here?|一名志愿者写道：“除了周四，我每晚都能给幼苗浇水。有人能 cover 那一天吗？”这里 cover 表示什么？|Do the task in the volunteer's place.|Put a cloth over the seedlings.|Write a report about Thursday.|前文留下周四浇水的任务空缺，因此 cover 是代班。|cover 也可指遮盖，需结合任务安排判断。

The concert ticket says, “Keep this stub for re-entry.” A visitor wants to leave during the break and return. Which item should the visitor keep?|演出票上写着“重新入场请保留此票根”。一名观众想在中场休息时出去再回来。应保留哪样东西？|The ticket stub.|The seat cushion.|A list of songs.|re-entry 是再次进入；票面明确要求保留 stub。|break 说明离场时机，不改变入场凭证。

Two notebooks cost the same. One has thick paper but fewer pages; the other has more thin pages. Sami needs many pages for pencil notes, and thick paper is unimportant to him. Which notebook better fits his needs?|两本笔记本价格相同。一本纸厚页少，另一本纸薄页多。萨米要记大量铅笔笔记，不在意纸厚。哪本更合适？|The one with more thin pages.|The one with fewer thick pages.|Only the one with the higher price.|明确的优先条件是页数，价格相同且厚度不重要。|不要把“纸厚”自动视作每个人的优先选择。

The handout says, “Underline the claim, then circle the example used to support it.” A student circles the claim and underlines the example. What needs changing?|讲义说：“在论点下划线，再圈出支持论点的例子。”学生圈了论点，给例子划了线。哪里要改？|Swap the two marks.|Find a second example.|Delete the claim.|对象找到了，但标记方式刚好反了，应交换圈和下划线。|题目问书写操作，不是让学生删改文章内容。

The school counted bicycles at its north gate from 7:30 to 8:00. It reported 38. A second gate was not observed. Which title describes the count most accurately?|学校在七点半至八点统计北门的自行车，共三十八辆，另一道门无人观察。哪个标题最准确？|Bicycles at the north gate during one half-hour.|All bicycles at school today.|The most popular way to reach school.|标题需同时保留一个校门和半小时这两个限制。|单点计数无法比较所有上学方式。

After losing his paper notes, Eli began photographing each page. “Now a windy day costs me less worry,” he says. Which problem is the new habit meant to reduce?|伊莱丢过纸质笔记后开始给每页拍照。他说：“现在刮风天我少操一份心。”这个新习惯想减少哪种麻烦？|Losing the information if a page blows away.|Taking too long to write each page.|Having too many photos on his phone.|即使原纸被吹走，照片仍保留内容，正对应此前丢笔记的经历。|拍照无法阻止纸被吹走，只能减少信息损失。

A notice says, “The side gate is closed while the wall is repaired. Deliveries may still enter through the yard.” A driver assumes all entrances are closed. Which phrase corrects that assumption?|通知说：“修墙期间侧门关闭。送货车辆仍可从院子进入。”司机认为所有入口都关闭了。哪句话能纠正他的理解？|Deliveries may still enter through the yard.|The side gate is closed.|While the wall is repaired.|still 与 through the yard 指明送货车辆有可用的替代入口。|一个入口关闭，不能推断所有入口都关闭。

Three classes voted on a reading room. Class A sent 8 votes for it out of 10 votes cast; Class B sent 12 out of 20. Which comparison is correct?|三个班就阅览室投票。A班所投十票中八票赞成，B班所投二十票中十二票赞成。哪项比较正确？|B had more votes for it, but A had a higher share in favor.|A had both more votes for it and a higher share.|B had a higher share because 12 is larger than 8.|B 赞成票数为十二，高于八；A 赞成比例为八成，高于 B 的六成。|票数与比例的分母不同，需分别比较。

Lea wrote, “I expected the repair to be quick. Two hours later I was still looking for the right screw.” Which attitude is most clearly suggested?|莉娅写道：“我原以为修理很快就好。两小时后我还在找合适的螺丝。”最明显反映出什么感受？|Surprise at how long a small detail took.|Pride that the whole job ended early.|Anger at someone who lost the screw.|expected quick 与 two hours later still 构成落差；文字没有指责任何人。|不要从耗时直接推测作者在生谁的气。

A recycling chart counts bottles by number, not by weight. On Tuesday there were more bottles, but most were tiny. What further fact is needed to compare the total weight from Monday and Tuesday?|回收图按瓶子的个数统计。周二瓶子更多，但大多很小。要比较周一和周二瓶子的总重量，还需什么？|The weight of the bottles collected on each day.|The color of the smallest bottles.|The number of collectors on Tuesday.|瓶数与单件重量都会影响总重，直接称出两天各自总重即可比较。|瓶子多不一定更重。

At a library meeting, Jo said, “Longer opening hours would help, provided there is an evening bus.” What is Jo's position?|图书馆会议上，乔说：“如果晚上有公交，延长开放时间会有帮助。”乔的立场是什么？|Support that depends on transport being available.|Support for longer hours under all conditions.|Opposition to any evening bus.|provided 引出成立条件，说明支持依赖夜间交通。|忽略条件从句就会把有条件支持读成无条件支持。

The sign by an orchard reads, “Take fallen fruit only.” A visitor picks an apple from a low branch because it is near the ground. Has the visitor followed the sign?|果园边的牌子写着“只可取落果”。访客从低枝上摘了一个苹果，理由是它接近地面。这样符合要求吗？|No. The apple was still attached to the tree.|Yes. Any low apple counts as fallen.|Yes, if the visitor eats it immediately.|fallen 描述已掉落的状态；树枝低并不说明果实脱离了树。|区分“位置靠下”和“已经掉落”。

The workshop has six seats. Its form says, “Submitting a form does not reserve a seat. Wait for our confirmation email.” Jia receives a copy of her form but no confirmation. What can she conclude?|工作坊有六个名额，表格写着“提交表格并不预留名额，请等候确认邮件”。嘉只收到了表格副本。她能得出什么结论？|Her seat has not yet been confirmed.|She definitely has one of the six seats.|Every seat has already been taken.|副本证明提交过表格，不等同于明确的名额确认。|没有确认也不能推出名额一定已满。

A coach measured the same runner on a flat track one day and a steep path the next. The second time was slower. Which fact makes a direct judgment about fitness difficult?|教练先在平坦跑道、次日在陡坡上为同一跑者计时。第二次更慢。哪一事实让直接判断体能变化变得困难？|The route difficulty changed.|The same runner took both tests.|The coach used the word slower.|场地难度不同，第二次变慢可能与坡度有关。|跑者相同并不能抵消路线不同的影响。

A photo caption says, “The square, usually crowded, just after the last bus on a rainy Tuesday.” What does the caption suggest about an empty square in this photo?|照片说明写着“平常拥挤的广场，摄于雨天周二末班车刚过之后”。这对照片中的空广场有什么提示？|The scene may be unusual for that place.|The square is always empty on weekdays.|The town has stopped running buses.|usually crowded 与特殊的天气和时间提醒读者照片并非日常全貌。|一张照片只能直接展示拍摄当时。

Two versions of a recipe use the same amount of flour. One says “a cup of chopped nuts”; the other says “chop a cup of nuts.” Why might the final amounts differ?|两版食谱所用面粉相同。一版写“一杯切碎的坚果”，另一版写“把一杯坚果切碎”。最终坚果用量为什么可能不同？|One measures the nuts after chopping and the other before.|One uses a larger cup by definition.|One adds flour to the measuring cup first.|chopped 作定语，说明量取时已经切碎；chop 作动作，发生在量取之后。|两个 cup 容积可以相同，差异来自装入的坚果形态。

A school tried a reminder bell for a week. Late arrivals fell from 12 to 6, but the nearby road also reopened that week. Which conclusion is best supported?|学校试用提醒铃一周，迟到人数从十二降到六；附近道路也恰在那周恢复通行。哪项结论最有依据？|Fewer late arrivals were recorded, but the bell's separate effect is unclear.|The bell alone prevented six late arrivals.|The road reopening had no possible effect.|迟到减少是记录事实；铃和道路同时变化，无法单独确定铃的效果。|时间上同时发生不等于已经确定唯一原因。

A club advertised a 50% increase in Saturday attendance. Its register rose from 4 names to 6. Which wording keeps both the proportion and its scale clear?|社团宣传周六到场人数增长了百分之五十，登记人数从四人变为六人。哪种表达同时交代比例和规模？|Attendance rose by two people, from four to six.|Half the town joined the club on Saturday.|Attendance increased by fifty people.|增加两人相对原来的四人是百分之五十，同时列出起止数便于判断规模。|百分比不是新增人数，也不代表全镇人口比例。

A writer says, “The route is shorter on paper; on wet days the steps may cost more time than the extra street.” Which claim does the writer question?|作者写道：“图上这条路线更短；雨天走台阶花的时间可能比绕一条街还多。”作者质疑哪种说法？|The shortest route always takes the least time.|The route with steps is shorter on the map.|Wet steps can slow a walker.|作者承认地图距离更短，用雨天的速度限制质疑“最短一定最快”。|不要把作者承认的事实误当作被质疑的观点。

The gardening team changed two things at once: it watered earlier and moved the pots into shade. Wilting became less common. Which follow-up would best separate the two changes?|园艺组同时提前浇水、把花盆移到阴凉处，萎蔫减少了。哪种后续做法最有助于区分两项改变的作用？|Compare similar pots while changing one condition at a time.|Change both things again in all pots.|Count only the pots that still wilt.|其他条件尽量相同、一次改变一项，才能更清楚地区分效应。|只挑仍萎蔫的盆会忽视没有萎蔫的情况。

A repair guide says, “If the screen stays dark after charging, check the cable before replacing the screen.” Which assumption does the guide warn against?|维修指南写着：“充电后屏幕仍黑，换屏前先检查线缆。”指南提醒人们避免什么假设？|A dark screen must mean the screen itself is broken.|A faulty cable can affect the result.|Checking the cable is possible.|指南给出另一种可能原因，因此不能把现象直接等同于屏幕损坏。|优先检查线缆不等于认定线缆必坏。

At a meeting, Lin said, “I agree the path needs lighting. My question is whether these lamps shine into bedroom windows.” Which response addresses Lin's concern?|会上，林说：“我同意小路需要照明。我想问，这些灯会不会照进卧室窗户？”哪种回应切中林的顾虑？|Show where the lamps point and how their light is shielded.|Repeat that walkers need a lit path.|List the total number of residents.|林已赞同照明目标，关注的是灯光方向及对屋内的影响。|重复双方同意的目标不能回答具体顾虑。

A notice promises, “We reply within two working days.” It says the desk works Monday to Friday and is closed on holidays.
